'''Hiroshi Kamiya''' (Japanese: '''神谷浩史''' ''Kamiya Hiroshi'') is a Japanese voice actor for {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Biography==
Kamiya was born on January 28, 1975 in {{wp|Matsudo}}, {{wp|Chiba}}, {{wp|Japan}}. He started working on {{aniseries|PTS}} with '{{aniseries|JN}}, voicing [[Quillon]].
